metadata.title: Chip stocks struggle in tech selloff as AMD shares tumble - MarketWatch

content.text:
20 hours ago
Chip stocks struggle in tech selloff as AMD shares tumble
The S&P 500’s information technology sector was struggling Thursday as chip stocks sold off.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was down 1.6% in early afternoon trading, as shares of chip companies such as Broadcom, Nvidia, Micron Technology and Advanced Micro Devices traded lower, according to FactSet data, at last check. AMD was down around 8%, one of the worst-performing stocks in the S&P 500 in afternoon trading, FactSet data showed.
The S&P 500’s tech sector was under pressure Thursday afternoon, down a sharp 1.4%, FactSet data showed, at last check.
